passage:
budget — 预算
The council had a budget of £120,000.

survey — 调查
Exactly 1,620 adults answered an online survey.

residents — 居民
The council asked the town's residents for their opinions.

repair — 修理
The town council had to decide whether to repair the roof or move the library to a larger building near the train station.

evidence — 证据
We are saying we need better evidence before we spend a large amount of money.” Some residents were unhappy.

temporary — 临时的
The council will put a temporary reading area in the town hall.

emergency — 紧急情况
The leader stressed that the emergency repair work would not affect the library's opening hours, except for the children's room.

documents — 文件
The council also said it would put all documents online so that residents can read them.
